comparison.objective: Open and safely retain a heavy laser-cutter lid; candidate fractures and recovers four installed insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Two-handed sustained lid lifting through a gas-strut takeover versus coaxial mandrel stabilization, separate-hammer impact control, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Lid fully open and held by struts without falling back versus four contact-driven notch fractures, four contained tangs, retained inserts, no damage, and stable release.
comparison.reason: Both are bimanual, but the tested mechanisms and abilities—assisted cover lifting versus precision impact fracture and loose-fragment recovery—are meaningfully different.
